title: Fix release sign-in connection in Android 1.0.8
summary: Version 1.0.7 inherited the development loopback API address. Release builds now always use the live HTTPS service; development overrides remain available.

changes.detail: Release API selection ignores development environment overrides and uses https://lecomax.com, preserving HTTPS validation and authentication.
Version 1.0.8/build 10 with matching Expo runtime isolates the corrected build from 1.0.7 updates.
Regression tests cover release builds inheriting loopback, LAN, staging and missing API configuration.

validation.name: Live endpoint connectivity
validation.detail: HTTPS request to /api/learning-mobile/auth reached the live server and received HTTP 405 for unsupported GET.

validation.name: Tests and device replacement
validation.detail: Pending regression tests, release rebuild, signature verification and phone launch.
